name: Stardew Valley

steps: Co-op → Host (or load a co-op farm) and make sure there are empty cabins.
Click Start sharing and send the invite code to your friends.
Type {{host}} and pick an empty cabin.

notes: Stardew's built-in invite codes (Steam/GOG) also work; TailLAN helps when those fail or players are on different stores. The joiner must not be hosting Stardew themselves (port 24642 must be free).
